_note: Template for the 'profile' vault item (the structure the code expects). Copy this shape, replace every synthetic value with your real one, then store it: python scripts/vault.py get profile -> edit in your editor -> python scripts/vault.py set profile. Arrays: every element carries a 'type' field, unique within its array - registry paths address elements by it (identities.self.first_name, vehicles.primary.currently_insured). Each insured asset's 'policy_doc' points at the PDF of the policy currently covering it; Headless extracts the coverage lines from that PDF (you confirm the extraction once) - current-policy data is never hand-typed into this document. 'feature_configs' holds per-feature settings (insurance.companies = which insurers to fetch quotes from). Never commit real values; this file stays synthetic. Policy: no passwords and no payment card data, in any field.
